theorem mean_median_le_sd {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
    [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : Ω → ℝ) (hXm : Measurable X)
    (hX : MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 P) (m : ℝ)
    (hm1 : 1 / 2 ≤ P.real {ω | X ω ≤ m}) (hm2 : 1 / 2 ≤ P.real {ω | m ≤ X ω}) : |∫ ω, X ω ∂P - m| ≤ Real.sqrt (ProbabilityTheory.variance X P)
problems.statement: Let X be a real random variable on a probability space with finite variance (X ∈ L²), mean μ = E[X] and standard deviation σ, and let m be a median of X, i.e. P(X ≤ m) ≥ 1/2 and P(X ≥ m) ≥ 1/2. Prove that |μ − m| ≤ σ.
